title: Social Proof
equation: Social Proof Strength = (Visibility + Similarity + Volume + Authenticity) ÷ 4
hook: When people aren't sure, they look at what people like them are doing. So show them.
statement: When people feel unsure, they follow others, especially people who seem similar to them.
explainer: In one energy study, telling people what their neighbors used beat every message about saving money or the planet. Proof from someone like me hits harder than any pitch.
sop: Collect testimonials from customers who look like your prospects.
Show real numbers where they're credible.
Use recognizable names or logos when you can.
Never fake proof. It backfires fast.
equation_example: Score each 1 to 10. Visibility 7, Similarity 9, Volume 5, Authenticity 8. (7 + 9 + 5 + 8) ÷ 4 = 7.25, call it 7.3. Higher means prospects trust your proof and lower their guard. Lower means it's too generic, hidden, or thin.
question: Find one testimonial from a customer who looks exactly like your ideal buyer and put it where prospects will see it.
closing_statement: People copy people who look like them.
caption:
Principle Nº 301: Social Proof

When people aren't sure, they look at what people like them are doing. So show them.

When people feel unsure, they follow others, especially people who seem similar to them.

Your turn: Find one testimonial from a customer who looks exactly like your ideal buyer and put it where prospects will see it.
